name: clean_orders
description: Cleans every orders-*.csv (or given files) from an input dir into an output dir with the same names (id,date,customer,amount; sorted, deduped, ISO dates). Returns per-file rows in/out and dropped counts.
whenToUse: Whenever raw order CSV exports need cleaning, including newly arrived ones.

provenance.reason: 8 raw CSVs now, more exports will arrive
